name: @kroma/release-tools
description: A testable Bun CLI that derives per-package version bumps and changelog entries from Conventional Commits, writes them into the native manifests (Cargo.toml / package.json / module.json), and can ask the local claude CLI (not the API) for a one-line human summary.
author: Maxime Scharwath <maxscharwath@gmail.com>
